families.title: Доставить помощь
families.evidence: Push the sealed trolley onto its receiving pad with its seal intact.
families.trigger: Hold the receiving terminal while the trolley occupies the pad.
families.failure: A marked crusher breaks the trolley seal.
families.reset: Restore the ticket trolley and seal.

families.title: Освободить человека
families.evidence: Weight the plate with a crate or settled limb, latch the gate, and guide the named adult across the refuge line.
families.trigger: Hold the refuge terminal after the adult crosses the line.
families.failure: A hazard hits the adult before refuge.
families.reset: Restore the same adult, gate and props.

families.title: Восстановить подачу
families.evidence: Throw a detached limb into the selected paddle and close the bypass switch.
families.trigger: Hold the output meter while its reading is stable.
families.failure: Closing the bypass before the paddle latches trips the fuse.
families.reset: Restore the paddle, bypass and fuse.

families.title: Закрыть слежку
families.evidence: Start the ticket recorder and hit its marked camera receptor with feces.
families.trigger: Hold the public terminal while the recorder shows camera interruption.
families.failure: Fouling the camera before starting the recorder.
families.reset: Clean the active receptor and restore its recorder.
